sourceObservation.method: Actual official UI selections and Download Full Checklist actions; original UTF-8 CSV captured from the rendered data:attachment/csv export anchor because the browser download event was unavailable. No CSV reformatting or value normalization.

sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 4,237 rows from the official Panini CSV export are retained, including all original columns, literal card-set parallel names and SEQUENCE values. Empty numbering is not an estimate. Pack odds are absent from this export. Product year does not establish a release date. This export was observed in the official interface on 2026-10-14; that observation is not a release date. Printed card-set identities naming other products are retained. Full product-guide and calendar-release reconciliation remain pending.
